quick-add.headline: Build the catalog. Skip the repetition.
quick-add.summary: Create WooCommerce products in batches using a table or JSON input, with validation and reusable templates.
quick-add.fit: A useful starting point when you have new stock to turn into product listings.

quick-edit.headline: A clearer way to change the catalog.
quick-edit.summary: A bulk-editing workspace for existing WooCommerce products, bringing product lists and updates into a focused interface.
quick-edit.fit: For the product information that needs to change after the catalog is already in place.

quick-variations.headline: Let the attributes do the multiplying.
quick-variations.summary: Generate WooCommerce variable-product combinations from configured attributes, then work with the resulting variations.
quick-variations.fit: For stores working with sizes, colours, and other attribute-based product choices.

quick-images.headline: Give the catalog a consistent look.
quick-images.summary: Batch-process product imagery with saved branding assets and WordPress Media Library integration.
features: Save results to the Media Library
quick-images.fit: For repeatable image preparation. Available formats and text rendering depend on the server’s image libraries.

quick-ship.headline: Make shipping rules easier to follow.
quick-ship.summary: A WooCommerce shipping setup wizard for structured zones and methods, with connected shipment and rule operations.
quick-ship.fit: For giving a store’s shipping setup a more structured starting point.

quick-points.headline: Give returning customers a reason to stay.
quick-points.summary: A WooCommerce points-and-rewards system covering awards, redemptions, tiers, and expiry rules.
quick-points.fit: For stores building a rewards workflow around their own customers.

quick-forms.headline: A form should lead somewhere useful.
quick-forms.summary: Build self-hosted forms with shortcode rendering, an administrative inbox, submissions, and notifications.
quick-forms.fit: For keeping form creation and the resulting enquiries in the WordPress workflow.

quick-schedule.headline: Give appointments a little structure.
quick-schedule.summary: Appointment scheduling and consultation fee handling, with appointment records and scheduled-job operations.
quick-schedule.fit: For organizing appointment-based work and its related administrative tasks.

quick-importer.headline: Move the data. Keep the structure.
quick-importer.summary: CSV import and export for WordPress content and WooCommerce products, including taxonomy and custom-field workflows.
quick-importer.fit: For moving repeatable content and product data without rebuilding the process each time.

quick-quotes.headline: Turn an enquiry into a clearer quote.
quick-quotes.summary: A quote-building workflow with administrative management and a frontend quote-request form.
quick-quotes.fit: For work that needs a defined proposal before it becomes an order.

quick-accountant.headline: Keep the small numbers in view.
quick-accountant.summary: An accounting-lite workspace for recording income, expenses, categories, budgets, and reports within WordPress.
quick-accountant.fit: For operational tracking. It does not replace professional accounting or tax advice.

quick-mail.headline: Keep the message and the delivery together.
quick-mail.summary: A self-hosted email-template and delivery layer for WordPress, using SMTP or supported provider APIs.
quick-mail.fit: For managing site email workflows. Delivery requires an appropriately configured mail provider.

quick-site.headline: Give the site some breathing room.
quick-site.summary: Self-hosted WordPress caching and optimization, with settings, cache controls, and database-cleanup tools.
quick-site.fit: For maintenance and optimization around the WordPress site you already run.

quick-seo.headline: Work on the details that search engines read.
quick-seo.summary: A WordPress and WooCommerce SEO workspace with spreadsheet-style metadata editing and structured-data tools.
features: Work with sitemaps, redirects, and link scans
quick-seo.fit: For hands-on SEO administration. Search rankings and indexing outcomes are not guaranteed.

quick-audit.headline: Look at the site in front of you.
quick-audit.summary: An internal SEO-audit tool for the current WordPress site, with scan and crawl operations and exportable results.
quick-audit.fit: For reviewing your own site. It is not presented as a competitor-research or external-site auditing service.

quick-traffic.headline: See the traffic. Keep the context.
quick-traffic.summary: Lightweight, self-hosted traffic monitoring with administrative analytics, UTM tools, and configurable exclusions.
quick-traffic.fit: For understanding site activity within a self-hosted WordPress workflow.

quick-code.headline: A place for the small pieces of code.
quick-code.summary: Admin-controlled HTML, CSS, and JavaScript injection with global and per-page targeting.
quick-code.fit: For authorized site administrators. Test custom snippets carefully before applying them to a live site.

quick-course-builder.headline: Give knowledge a path to follow.
quick-course-builder.summary: A WordPress course-creation and delivery system organized around courses, modules, tests, and certificates.
features: Create tests and manage course status
quick-course-builder.fit: For structured educational content. The plugin header requires WordPress 6.2+ and PHP 8.0+.

quick-connector.headline: One bridge between the site and the desktop.
quick-connector.summary: The server-side control plane connecting WordPress and WooCommerce operations with QuickWoo Desktop.
features: Provide site, store, and plugin management endpoints
quick-connector.fit: Required on each connected WordPress site. Use HTTPS and an authorized WordPress user with an Application Password.

quick-license.headline: The licensing layer behind the suite.
quick-license.summary: The self-hosted license-generation and activation authority used by the QuickWoo ecosystem.
quick-license.fit: Infrastructure, not a separately priced Pro plugin in this matrix. A standalone customer-facing price is not specified.
